name: Vehicle or equipment hit an aircraft
description: A vehicle, cart or piece of equipment collided with an aircraft by accident.

name: Manual handling injury
description: Someone was hurt lifting, pushing, pulling or carrying.

name: Near miss
description: Something nearly happened but nobody was hurt and nothing was hit.

name: Foreign object debris
description: A loose item was found where it should not be on the working area.

name: Equipment fault
description: A machine or vehicle failed or behaved wrongly.

name: Jet blast
description: Engine blast moved people or equipment.

name: Other
description: Anything that does not fit the types above.
